blocks.text: BTS’s arrival in Lima, Peru prompted a series of citywide events ranging from a temporarily renamed street to the group’s car getting mobbed by fans on the streets. The K-pop supergroup kicked off their tour in the city last Wednesday with a final show set to take place on Saturday, Oct. 10, at Estadio San Marcos. Upon their arrival, the car carrying the K-pop group was mobbed by fans, with videos showing a crowd surrounding the vehicle as people attempted to film the boys.
